My Last Little Love Letter

From Ziyan Uddin, with all the words that sometimes feel too big to say aloud.

Afia, agar meri zindagi ek kahani hai, toh tum uska sabse khoobsurat hissa ho. Tumhari ek muskurahat mere din ko roshan kar deti hai, aur tumhara hona mere liye kisi dua ke qabool hone jaisa hai.

Main tumse sirf aaj nahi, har us kal ke liye mohabbat karta hoon jo hum saath likhenge. Tum meri khushi ho, meri sukoon ho, aur woh naam ho jo dil khud-ba-khud leta hai.

Forever yours,
Ziyan Uddin
Tum saamne ho toh dil ko aur kya chahiye,
Tum muskura do toh duniya se kya chahiye.
Ziyan ki har dua mein bas tumhara naam hai,
Afia, tum mil jao toh aur kya chahiye.
One last little question...

Afia, will you be my Valentine?

I promise more soft mornings, spontaneous adventures, and reasons to smile. But mostly, I promise to keep choosing you.

Take your time — this little page will wait for you.
